findingIds: Affected baseline scope is 64 items; reconciliation covers all 64 uniquely with 63 classified missing_from_source/accurately_unavailable and 1 classified artifact/not_applicable, with no duplicate reconciled keys.
The current restaurant-controlled catalog is incomplete and cannot establish that baseline products are absent, that allergen arrays are complete, or that any unlisted allergen is absent.
No restaurant-issued allergen matrix, complete ingredient document, or cross-contact disclosure was found; cross-contact therefore remains unresolved rather than negative or positive.
The homepage phrase “New American-Inspired cuisine” is marketing copy rather than a menu product and is correctly classified as an artifact.
The multi-service, scope-incomplete, difficult-extraction/parser, validation-warning, low-confidence, and scout-risk gates are substantively supported.

Frozen restaurant-issued item evidence supports narrow explicit positives, including egg in All American; egg and milk in the breakfast burritos and Classic Breakfast Sandwich; egg in Protein Bowl and Scrambled Eggs; milk in Weekday Avocado Toast; and tree-nut identity in Almond Milk and Toasted Almond.

Terra’s broad statement that all frozen food and beverage allergen evidence is unavailable over-corrects the record by erasing explicit restaurant-issued ingredient descriptions and unavoidable named identities.
The count_drift gate does not demonstrate actual catalog drift: zero independently enumerable current products reflects inaccessible dynamic extraction, not a verified current product count of zero.

The non_exact_reconciliation gate should not be generalized to all item mappings; the packet reports only two non-exact reconciliations, including the marketing artifact and normalized San Pellegrino presentation.

Names such as brioche, multigrain bread, avocado toast, French toast, pancakes, waffles, or an unspecified flour tortilla do not independently justify promoting wheat, gluten, egg, or milk without explicit restaurant-issued composition evidence.
Optional additions such as whipped cream or Nutella cannot be promoted as allergens inherent to the base Pancakes or Waffle items.
Coconut cold foam supports a coconut ingredient observation but does not, by itself, justify the frozen tree-nut allergen classification.
